'''Oarr''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, lacking [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] worked as a vendor on board the [[Ilum Orbital Station (Imperial)|Imperial station]] which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

==Behind the scenes==
Oarr first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a security key vendor on the Imperial orbital station above Ilum.
